get.description:
Retrieves a specific runner (runner set) by ID. Returns the runner configuration, status, labels, and associated metadata for the authenticated organization.

A runner set defines the configuration template for runner instances that will be provisioned when CI/CD jobs request matching labels.

## Code Examples

### Shell (curl)

```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.warpbuild.com/api/v1/runners/wzvojxk17eo3s1dq" \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer <your-api-key>" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

### Example Response

```json
{
  "id": "wzvojxk17eo3s1dq",
  "created_at": "2024-10-09T17:28:02.050974Z",
  "updated_at": "2024-10-09T17:28:02.050974Z",
  "name": "warpdev-custom-test-custom-image",
  "vcs_integration_id": "gh-wc0y0ob3oqymfsmj",
  "configuration": {
    "sku": "4x-x64-w1kkdpjem73cmowh",
    "storage": {
      "tier": "low",
      "size": 150,
      "iops": 3200,
      "throughput": 250,
      "disk_type": "pd-balanced",
      "performance_tier": ""
    },
    "image": "wjqcx6ozzghczk5x",
    "capacity_type": "ondemand"
  },
  "stock_runner_id": null,
  "organization_id": "wfmn080eif8rniwq",
  "labels": [
    "warpdev-custom-test-custom-image"
  ],
  "active": true,
  "provider_id": "",
  "meta": {}
}
```

### TypeScript

```typescript
const response = await fetch(
  'https://api.warpbuild.com/api/v1/runners/wzvojxk17eo3s1dq',
  {
    method: 'GET',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': 'Bearer <your-api-key>',
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    }
  }
);
const runner = await response.json();
console.log(runner.name); // "warpdev-custom-test-custom-image"
console.log(runner.configuration.sku); // "4x-x64-w1kkdpjem73cmowh"
```

### Python

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    'https://api.warpbuild.com/api/v1/runners/wzvojxk17eo3s1dq',
    headers={
        'Authorization': 'Bearer <your-api-key>',
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    }
)
runner = response.json()
print(runner['name'])  # "warpdev-custom-test-custom-image"
print(runner['configuration']['sku'])  # "4x-x64-w1kkdpjem73cmowh"
```

ami_id.description: AmiID is the AWS AMI ID of the customer-owned image.

root_device_name.description:
RootDeviceName is the root device name of the AMI (e.g. /dev/sda1).
Defaults are resolved from the AMI when omitted.

arch.description: Arch is the CPU architecture (x64 or arm64)

imdsv2_required.description:
IMDSv2Required when set to true, enforces IMDSv2 and disables IMDSv1 for EC2 instances.
This is only applicable for AWS EC2 based runners. Passing this for
other providers will have no effect.
This helps prevent Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attacks.
Default is false (both IMDSv1 and IMDSv2 are allowed).

instance_types.description: InstanceTypes lists acceptable EC2/GCE/Azure instance types

is_public.description: IsPublic indicates whether instances should have public IPs

network_tier.description:
NetworkTier is the network tier associated with the instance.
This is only applicable for GCP based runners. Passing this for
other providers will have no effect.

Possible values:

- PREMIUM: A premium network tier with fast network performance.

- STANDARD: A standard network tier with basic features.

Refer: https://cloud.google.com/network-tiers

Default value is automatically picked if nothing is passed in case of GCP.

+Default: STANDARD

role_arn.description: RoleARN is the AWS IAM role ARN for assuming cloud permissions

image_uri.description:
ImageURI is the full uri of the image.
This can be used to download the image

+OutputOnly

volume_size_gb.description:
VolumeSizeGB is the size of the volume in GB.
This is used when creating a snapshot out of the volume.

This is rounded up to the nearest GiB.

alias.description:
Alias is the human-friendly name of the image. Unique within the
organization and immutable after creation.

arch.description:
Arch is the CPU architecture. For byoc_ami images this is derived from
the AMI when available and may be omitted.

os.description:
OS of the image. For byoc_ami images this is derived from the AMI and
may be omitted.

stack_id.description:
StackID is the infrastructure stack (kind + region, e.g. an EC2 stack)
the image belongs to. Required for byoc_ami; must be omitted for
container images.

type.description: Type determines which of the type-specific payloads below is used.

warpbuild_snapshot_image.description:
WarpbuildSnapshotImage is the vm image used by warpbuild to run the jobs.
This will have the info for internal images managed by warpbuild when
type = 'warpbuild_managed'.

In case of container images, this will have the base image of the VM on
which the container is run.

tmpl_params.description:
TmplParams can be use for create flow.

Supported keys:

"VpcCIDR": string

"PublicSubnet1CIDR": string

"PrivateSubnet1CIDR": string

"EnablePrivateSubnets": bool

"Region": string

is_preferred.description:
Deprecated: IsPreferred is no longer consulted by the routing
binders — preference is encoded in the routing tree's entry order.
The (kind, region) invariant requires exactly one active stack,
so there's nothing to break ties on. Field stays for compatibility
with stored rows; will be removed once data is audited and the
column is dropped.

cache_bucket.description:
Distinct R2 buckets (eu vs. us) are separate
stack rows, matching the per-stack-account model above.

active.description: Active indicates whether the runner is enabled

configuration.description: Configuration contains the hardware and OS settings

created_at.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp when the runner was created

id.description: Id is the unique identifier for the runner

labels.description: Labels are custom tags for runner selection in CI workflows

name.description: Name is the display name of the runner

pool_size.description:
PoolSize is the number of warm pool instances. Populated on the public
GET /runners endpoints; 0 when the runner has no warm pool.

provider_id.description: ProviderId is the stack ID the BYOC runner set provisions into

stock_runner_id.description: StockRunnerId references a stock runner template if applicable

updated_at.description: UpdatedAt is the timestamp when the runner was last updated

vcs_integration_id.description:
Deprecated: runner sets are organization-global — never read this for logic. It is
only still stamped on create (any connected GitHub org, not "the serving org") so
previous releases keep working after a code rollback.

arch.description: Arch is the CPU architecture (x64 or arm64)

deprecated.description:
Deprecated indicates the image is still functional but should not be
picked for new workflows. Currently populated only for
`warpbuild_managed` images; other types default to false.

version.description:
Version is the latest version of the runner image.
This is present if the runner image is available to be used.

This is only populated by the runner image GET endpoint.

This is not populated if the type is 'warpbuild_managed'.

warpbuild_image.description:
WarpbuildImage is the vm image used by warpbuild to run the jobs.
This will have the info for internal images managed by warpbuild when
type = 'warpbuild_managed'.

In case of container images, this will have the base image of the VM on
which the container is run.

warpbuild_snapshot_image.description:
WarpbuildSnapshotImage contains the latest mutation request made on the
runner image.

Use warpbuild_image field instead if you wish to get the ami id

file.description:
File is the base64 encoded file.
This must be a shell script which is encoded in base64.

type.description: Type is the type of hook.

purge_image_versions_offset.description:
PurgeImageVersionsOffset is the number of versions to keep.
Each time a new version is created, the oldest version is purged.
Allowed values range [1, inf).

Default value is 2.

arch.description: Arch is the CPU architecture (x64 or arm64)

expires_at.description:
ExpiresAt is the time at which the runner image version expires.
This is only populated for warpbuild snapshot images and the status is
'available'.

external_id.description: ExternalID is the ID of the runner image version in the external system.

byoc_sku.description: ByocSku contains BYOC (Bring Your Own Cloud) configuration

capacity_type.description: CapacityType specifies spot or on-demand instances

image.description: Image is the base image for the runner (e.g., ubuntu-2404, macos-14)

sku.description: Sku is the WarpBuild SKU identifier for managed runners

storage.description: Storage contains disk configuration for the runner

configuration.description: Configuration specifies the hardware and OS settings for the runner

labels.description: Labels are custom tags for runner selection in CI workflows

name.description: Name is a unique identifier for the runner within the organization

pool_size.description: PoolSize specifies the number of warm pool instances

provider_id.description: ProviderId is the stack ID the BYOC runner set provisions into

vcs_integration_id.description:
Deprecated: runner sets are organization-global and serve all connected GitHub
orgs; this field is ignored (a server-side value is stamped instead, for rollback
compatibility).

disk_type.description:
DiskType is the disk type associated with the instance.

This is only applicable for GCP based runners for now. Passing this for
other providers will have no effect.

Possible values:

- pd-standard: Standard persistent disk.

- pd-ssd: SSD persistent disk.

- pd-balanced: Balanced persistent disk.

- pd-extreme: Extreme persistent disk. (to be added later)

- hyperdisk-balanced: Hyperdisk balanced persistent disk.

- hyperdisk-extreme: Hyperdisk extreme persistent disk.

Refer: https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/disks#disk-types

Default value is automatically picked if nothing is passed in case of GCP.

+Default: pd-ssd

iops.description: IOPS is the provisioned IOPS of the storage.

performance_tier.description:
PerformanceTier is the provider specific performance tier of the storage.
This is applicable for Azure as of now, can be extended to other providers in the future.
Passing this for other providers will have no effect.

Refer: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-machines/disks-change-performance

Possible values:

- P15
- P20
- P30
- P40
- P50

Default value is automatically picked if nothing is passed in case of Azure.

+Default: P15

throughput.description: Throughput is the provisioned throughput of the storage in MiB/s.

tier.description:
Tier is the tier of the storage.

If GCP based, you must set this to custom.

warpbuild_snapshot_image.description:
WarpbuildSnapshotImage is the vm image used by warpbuild to run the jobs.
This will have the info for internal images managed by warpbuild when
type = 'warpbuild_managed'.

In case of container images, this will have the base image of the VM on
which the container is run.

configuration.description: Configuration specifies the updated hardware and OS settings

labels.description: Labels are updated custom tags for runner selection

name.description: Name is the new unique identifier for the runner

pool_size.description: PoolSize specifies the number of warm pool instances

ami_id.description:
AMIID is the ID of the AMI.

+OutputOnly

creator_runner_instance_id.description:
CreatorRunnerInstanceID is the ID of the runner instance that created the snapshot.
This is populated via the auth token.

+OutputOnly

provider.description:
Provider is the cloud provider of the snapshot.

+OutputOnly

snapshot_id.description:
SnapshotID is the ID of the snapshot.

+OutputOnly

vcs_organization_name.description:
VCSOrganizationName is the name of the VCS organization.
This is populated via the auth token.

+OutputOnly

vcs_ref_name.description:
VCSRefName is the name of the VCS ref.
This is populated via the auth token.

+OutputOnly

vcs_repository_name.description:
VCSRepositoryName is the name of the VCS repository.
This is populated via the auth token.

+OutputOnly

version_id.description:
VersionID is the ID of the version.
This is used when creating a new version of the snapshot.
